_about: Largest box each image is DRAWN in, in 1280x710 design px (the #app canvas), derived 2026-11-04 from each part's css/style.css with object-fit applied: a 'contain' image lists the box its pixels occupy, a 'cover' image lists the frame, a percentage crop lists the scaled image. The zoom panel (.img-zoom-panel 660x660, stage img contain) is included for every image a zoom button points at. reencode-media.py resizes to 2 x the box (cover rule: the larger of the two ratios), never upscales, and skips a shrink under 10 %. point.png (01) and orange.png (03) are referenced nowhere and are not listed.
